The real-provider requalification of the permission case is done by the conductor after this plan, not here.  Go standard library only, conventional commits. The policy's decision itself does not change: nothing outside the worktree is approved, and `execute` requests without locations are still denied (approving a codex escalation would run the command outside its sandbox with full access). Only the consequence of a denial changes, so that it matches the CLI path.
